ops.oldText: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.

ops.oldText: Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
ops.newText: Customer's obligation to pay all amounts due under this Agreement is not damages and is not limited by this Section.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The cap is pegged to the defined term "Fees", which is only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the limitation is illusory; we have reset the basis to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, consistent with our limitation-of-liability position. We also broadened 21.3 so Customer's obligation to pay all amounts due is not treated as damages; mutuality, the damages exclusions in 21.2 and the Excluded Claims carve-outs are unchanged.
proposal.summary: Reset 21.1 cap to greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, and broaden the payment-obligations carve-out in 21.3

mappings.quote: The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.

mappings.element: Cap equal to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.

mappings.quote: neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages
or consequential damages, or for lost profits, revenues, or goodwill, to the extent those damages are legally excludable
“Excluded Claims” means a Party's breach of confidentiality

mappings.element: Uncapped breach of data protection obligations.

mappings.quote: infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property

mappings.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.
